name: Glass Input Field

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Top search pill 'Search for songs, artists...' in reference; global course/note/chat search in product
Large Codex-style multiline composer card with toolbar + send button

representativeVariants.whySelected: Dominant top-bar form in reference and in macOS toolbars
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: leading 18px search icon, placeholder, trailing kbd badge (⌘K)

representativeVariants.whySelected: Focus state is where glass deepens — fill becomes more opaque, hairline brightens
The Agent hero control — large rounded glass card modeled on Codex composer
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: auto-growing textarea; bottom toolbar: mode chip (Full access), project picker, plugins, model menu, mic; circular primary send button on the right

anatomy: trailing accessory cluster: clear / kbd / mic / send
structurePatterns: Placeholder and icons use muted-foreground at ~60% contrast
Composer toolbar items are ghost icon buttons 28-32px; send is the only primary control

usageHints.do: Deepen the glass on focus rather than drawing a heavy border; keep composer as the visually heaviest surface in the chat column
usageHints.avoid: No inset inner shadow; do not put saturated borders at rest

keyInsightSeed: Inputs are shallow glass at rest and deepen on focus — the interface leans toward attention.
